record.name: Sentry
record.one_liner: Sentry web API and OAuth2/Auth tokens for managing Sentry platform resources and data programmatically.

auth.notes: Sentry supports both API authentication tokens (passed via Bearer auth header, created via internal integrations or user personal tokens) and OAuth2 with the authorization code grant type for third-party applications.

access.notes: Users can sign up for a free account/developer plan directly on Sentry's website without requiring sales intervention.

api_surface.notes: The public web API is documented under v0, supporting REST-style endpoints accessed via tokens or OAuth2.

mcp.notes: Sentry mentions offering a Sentry MCP server and MCP access on pricing and documentation pages.

buildability.reasoning: Sentry offers self-serve account sign-up and thoroughly documented API authentication tokens and OAuth2 flows, making it easy for an outside developer to build an integration.

evidence.claim: The Sentry web API is used to access the Sentry platform programmatically (version v0).
Sentry supports OAuth2 with the authorization code grant type as well as Bearer token authentication.
Users can sign up for a free account to start using Sentry.
Sentry provides and maintains SDKs for various popular languages and frameworks.
